title: BSOS Developer Portal
excerpt: Integrate BSOS API into SaaS platforms, CRMs, helpdesks and enterprise applications.
content_html:
BUSINESS COMMUNICATION INTELLIGENCE

Turn business communication into actionable intelligence.

BSOS analyzes business communications across ten intelligence layers and returns structured output your software can use to understand, prioritize, route, escalate and automate.

Real-time API Structured intelligence output

Enterprise Ready Designed for software integration

Built for Scale High-volume communication processing

BSOS Intelligence Output

Structured JSON 

{
  "classification": {
    "domain": "operations",
    "type": "service_incident"
  },

  "business_impact": {
    "level": "high",
    "customer_impact": true
  },

  "attention": {
    "requires_attention": true,
    "time_sensitive": true
  },

  "priority": {
    "level": "high"
  },

  "action": {
    "action_required": true,
    "recommended_action":
      "Escalate to operations"
  }
}

B

FROM COMMUNICATION TO ACTION

See what BSOS can extract from a business communication.

One message can contain operational impact, customer risk, urgency, commercial consequences and an implicit need for action. BSOS separates those signals into structured intelligence.

Support Ticket

Production service unavailable

Our production environment has been unavailable for 45 minutes and more than 200 employees can no longer process customer orders.

We need an immediate update and escalation.

→

B

Business Signal Operating System

Multi-layer communication intelligence.

→

Classification Operational Incident

Business Impact High

Attention Required

Priority High

Time Sensitive Yes

Recommended Action Escalate

→

Your product can use BSOS intelligence to:

Route to Operations

Trigger Escalation

Create High-Priority Work

Alert Responsible Teams

Enrich Agent Context

BSOS INTELLIGENCE

One API. Ten layers of intelligence for business communication.

BSOS does not return a single score. It exposes distinct intelligence layers your product can contract and consume independently.

Business Signals

Detect meaningful events, changes, commitments, risks and signals contained in communication.

signals

Message Understanding

Understand what is happening, what the sender means and what the communication is trying to achieve.

understanding

Business Context

Identify commercial, operational, organizational and relationship context surrounding the message.

context

Business Classification

Classify communication by business domain, message type, intent and operational meaning.

classification

Business Facts

Extract concrete business facts, entities, quantities, events and explicit commitments.

business_facts

Business Impact

Evaluate operational, financial, customer and commercial consequences.

business_impact

Attention Intelligence

Determine whether attention is required, how quickly and whether the communication can be ignored.

attention

Priority Intelligence

Determine relative priority based on urgency, impact, risk and business relevance.

priority

Recommended Action

Return a structured recommendation describing the most appropriate next action.

action

Decision Explainability

Explain why BSOS reached the result and surface the business evidence supporting the decision.

explainability

BUILT FOR INTEGRATION

Add communication intelligence across your product.

BSOS is designed as an intelligence layer for software that already receives or processes business communication.

Helpdesk & ITSM

Prioritize tickets, detect incidents and surface escalation requirements.

CRM & Sales

Detect opportunities, objections, commercial intent and commitments.

Operations

Detect operational incidents, blockers, dependencies and disruption.

Customer Success

Identify dissatisfaction, churn risk and relationship changes.

Legal & Compliance

Surface obligations, deadlines, contractual signals and risk.

Finance & Procurement

Detect invoices, approvals, payment issues and vendor requirements.

BSOS PARTNER ACCESS

From access to production in seven steps.

01

Request Access

Tell us about your company and use case.

02

Partner Review

We review the platform and integration fit.

03

Owner Account

Create the organization owner account.

04

Invite Team

Add technical and product teammates.

05

Select Capacity

Choose the processing capacity required.

06

Provision Access

Create Sandbox or Production API access.

07

Validate & Go Live

Validate the integration and begin processing.

BUILD WITH BSOS

Add business communication intelligence to your product.

Start with the Sandbox, choose the intelligence capabilities your product needs and integrate structured BSOS output into your own workflows.
